# v0.4.5 — A living mark, a setup that asks first, and topic sessions in the sidebar

## What's changed

- **A short setup after installing or updating.** The first time DSH opens with this version, TheOne shows a full-window setup, one page at a time: a welcome, what's new, then three choices — whether to organize earlier chats, where topic sessions go, and how main chat marks which topic a message went to. Each choice is an existing setting and can be changed later in TheOne's settings; "Set up later" leaves everything as it is. Someone who already agreed to organizing earlier chats is not asked again. It opens once, for new and updating users alike.
- **Topic sessions can sit in the sidebar.** A new setting, "Hide topic sessions", is off by default: the sessions TheOne keeps for each topic now appear in DSH's sidebar beside your own. Turn it on, or choose "Topic list" in the setup, to keep them only in the topic list as before. Only sessions TheOne put away itself are brought back; sessions you archived stay archived.
- **A living mark.** TheOne's ring-and-dot mark is now a cell with one nucleus that breathes slowly, a little livelier while main chat is open. It is drawn as plain vector paths, so it stays sharp at small sizes, and it holds still when your system asks for reduced motion.
- **The pumpkin is the cell.** On 30 and 31 October the cell itself turns into a pumpkin, with lobes, ribs and a swaying stem, instead of a furry pumpkin behind the mark.

After updating: if TheOne had been keeping its topic sessions out of the sidebar, they come back into it. Choose "Topic list" in the setup to keep them out.

Validation: type checks and the full automated suite (423 tests, including the new setting, its save and reload, archiving only what TheOne put away, and the setup notice) pass on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; the setup was walked through end to end in an isolated DSH web profile in dark and light themes, and the plugin archive builds.

## 中文

- **安装或更新后有一个简短的设置向导**：这个版本第一次打开时，TheOne 会显示一个全屏的设置流程，一页一个：欢迎、新功能，然后是三个选择——要不要整理以前的聊天、话题会话放在哪里、主聊天里怎么提示消息去了哪个话题。每个选择都对应一项已有设置，之后都能在 TheOne 设置里修改；点「稍后设置」则什么都不改。已经同意过整理旧聊天的人不会再被问一次。新用户和更新的用户都只会看到一次。
- **话题会话可以显示在侧边栏**：新增设置「隐藏话题会话」，默认关闭：TheOne 为每个话题保留的会话，现在会和你自己的会话一起出现在 DSH 侧边栏里。打开这项设置，或在设置向导里选「话题列表」，就会像以前一样只收在话题列表里。只有 TheOne 自己收起来的会话会被放回来，你自己归档的会话保持不变。
- **会呼吸的标识**：TheOne 的圆环加圆点标识换成了一个带细胞核的细胞，会慢慢呼吸，打开主聊天时稍微活跃一点。全部用矢量路径绘制，小尺寸下也清晰；系统开启「减少动态效果」时保持静止。
- **南瓜就是这个细胞**：10 月 30 日和 31 日，细胞本身会变成一颗有分瓣、瓜棱和摇摆瓜蒂的南瓜，不再是标识背后的毛绒南瓜。

更新后：如果 TheOne 之前把话题会话收在了侧边栏之外，它们会回到侧边栏。想继续收起来，在设置向导里选「话题列表」即可。

验证：在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 上类型检查和全部自动化测试（423 项，含新设置的保存与重新加载、只放回 TheOne 自己收起的会话、设置向导的显示标记）通过；在隔离的 DSH 网页 profile 中以深色和浅色主题完整走过设置流程；插件包构建正常。
